[[Pete (DS)|Pete]] (Possible husband) |rival = |wife lunches = |unlock by = Connect to [[Harvest Moon: Friends of Mineral Town|FoMT]] or [[Harvest Moon: More Friends of Mineral Town|MFoMT]] |extra marriage requirements = |event path = |appearances = [[Elli (HM64)|HM64]], [[Elli (BTN)|BTN, HMfG, B&G]], [[Elli (FoMT)|FoMT, MFoMT]], DS, Cute, [[Elli (ToT)|ToT]], [[Elli (MLS)|MLS]], [[Elly (SoSFoMT)|SoSFoMT]] }} {{Youmay|Elli, a character from [[Harvest Moon DS]]|[[Elli]] in her other appearances throughout the series}} {{Nihongo|Elli|エリス|Erisu|Elise}} is a character in ''[[Harvest Moon DS]]'' and ''[[Harvest Moon DS: Cute]].'' She is one of the eligible bachelorettes to court in ''DS''. '''Elli''' is unlocked after connecting ''DS'' and ''Cute'' to ''[[Harvest Moon: Friends of Mineral Town]] ''and ''[[Harvest Moon: More Friends of Mineral Town]]'' via GBA connection. Elli visits [[Forget-Me-Not Valley (DS)|Forget-Me-Not Valley]] on Wednesdays from [[Mineral Town]] with [[Trent (DS)|Doctor Trent]]. They both study medicine at the clinic in the mornings, but can be found around the Goddess Pond in the afternoon on sunny days. When it's raining, Elli will go to the mansion instead. Elli is a caring person who is curious about medicine and wants to use her abilities to help people. Because Elli is only in town Wednesdays, she will be a difficult girl to court, as this is the only time that you can give her gifts. Her heart level is difficult to track because it is invisible unless you are equipped with the Love Bangle. Marrying any Mineral Town bachelorette in ''DS'' will cause the game to end. After the credits finished rolling, players can resume from their last save data. ==Gifts[https://fogu.com/hm6/chan3/elli.php Elli Likes/Dislikes] fogu.com== {{Infobox Gift |special = Moon Dumpling |loved = Jewelry (All), Flowers (All, except Moondrop Flower), Strawberry, Milk, Diamond, Pink Diamond, Lithograph, Dumpling Powder, Hot Milk, Roasted Rice Cake, Strawberry Milk, Sponge Cake, Elli Leaves |liked = Banana, Yogurt, Blue Grass, Purple Grass, Indigo Grass, Black Grass, White Grass, Fish, Dress, Sunblock Facial Pack, Skin Lotion, Emerald, Ruby, Topaz, Amethyst, Chocolate, Popcorn, French Toast, Doughnut, Grilled Fish, Pancake, Risotto, Hot Chocolate, Fish Stew, Boiled Spinach, Candied Potato, Strawberry Jam, Apple Jam, Grape Jam, Mountain Stew, Porridge, Relaxtea, Baked Yam, Cookies, Chocolate Cookies, Cake, Chocolate Cake, Cheesecake, Apple Pie, Grape Juice, Banana Juice, Vegetable Juice, Vegetable Latte, Mixed Latte, Fish Sticks, Green Dumpling, Chimaki, Steamed Bun, Steamed Egg, Chinese Bun, Steamed Cake, Pudding, Pumpkin Pudding, Salad, Sandwich, Sushi, Chirashi Sushi, Ice Cream, Relaxtea Leaves |disliked = Corn, Onion, Pepper, Yellow Grass, Wine, Stir Fry, Fried Rice, Scrambled Eggs, Omelet, Omelet Rice, Wild Grape Wine, Marmalade, Ketchup |hated = Toadstool, Pirate Treasure, Fish Fossil |horror = Tomato Juice}} ==Heart Events== '''Black Heart Event''' Pass out from exhaustion on Wednesday. This event will only trigger if the player has fainted at least 50 times before trying to see this event.[https://fogu.com/hm6/chan3/elli.php Elli Heart Events] fogu.com When you wake up the next morning, you will see Elli beside you, warning you not to work until you faint. She was worried about you and reminds you to be more careful. If you thank her for the help, she will tell you that you've been a good patient and leave. {{Clr}} ---- '''Purple Heart Event''' Walk from the main road to the mansion between 3pm and 6pm on a rainy Wednesday.[https://fogu.com/hm6/chan3/elli.php Elli Heart Events] fogu.com Elli must have a purple heart or more and the black heart event must be viewed. As you walk towards Romana's mansion, you will see Elli and realize she's hurt. Elli explains that she fell down the outside steps when leaving the mansion. You volunteer yourself to take her back to the clinic and Elli agrees to go. Hardy tells Elli that her injury isn't bad enough to have to come to the hospital. He scolds her for not knowing better! Elli sadly admits that she panics when she gets injured. Hardy tries to encourage her by saying that Elli needs to remain calm for the sake of her own patients. Elli thanks you and leaves to go back to the mansion. {{Clr}} ---- '''Blue Heart Event''' Walk to the mansion between 2pm and 7pm on a rainy Wednesday.[https://fogu.com/hm6/chan3/elli.php Elli Heart Events] fogu.com Elli must have a blue heart or more and all previous heart events must be viewed. As you walk into the mansion, you'll see Elli and Romana together in Romana's room. Elli has come to give Romana's sore and tired legs a massage. Elli read about a massage technique in a book and is hoping that it will work for Romana. Romana is impressed with Elli's dedication towards helping others. If you agree with Romana and say that you respect Elli, she will thank both of you. {{Clr}} ---- '''Yellow Heart Event''' Exit your farmhouse from 6am to 8am on a sunny Wednesday when Elli has a yellow heart or more, assuming that all previous heart events have been viewed.[https://fogu.com/hm6/chan3/elli.php Elli Heart Events] fogu.com When you leave your farmhouse in the morning, Elli will be standing outside your front door. Elli asks if you ever feel tired from all your farm work and thinks she has something that might help. If you accept her offer, she will give you Elli Leaves. ==References== {{reflist|2}} {{HMDSCharacters}} [[Category:Harvest Moon DS]] [[Category:Harvest Moon DS Bachelorettes]] [[Category:Harvest Moon DS Characters]] [[Category:Harvest Moon DS: Cute]] [[Category:Harvest Moon DS: Cute Characters]]
